This topic is part of the AQA GCSE Psychology specification.

Perception appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Perception in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Perception.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
